question: How does the cosmic form consume and scorch all worlds?
premises: The form licks and devours worlds on all sides
Blazing mouths fill the whole world with radiance
inference: The cosmic form is an all-consuming, world-filling radiance
plain_english: You lick and devour all worlds on every side with blazing mouths; filling the whole world with radiance, your fierce rays scorch, O Viṣṇu.
